tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyan gos ldan pa'i don ni bsam bya zhing*/ /bung ba'i mdog can lce yi rtse la blang*/ /zur 'debs 'phul sman sogs la mi ltos pa'i/ /kyai rdor dkyil chog sman gyi rgyal po'o/ /

na mo gu ru mañdzu badzrā ya/ rnam pa kun ldan 'ja' tshon sgyu ma'i sku/ /mchog tu bde chen snying rje'i ros gang ba'i/ /srid dang srid min bdud kyi mgo bor ni// g.yo med zung 'jug gar gyis rol der 'dud/ /sku gnyis phan tshun rgyu dang 'bras bu'am/ /rigs 'gal khro chags phan tshun rgyas 'debs pas/ /rigs nges rgyud kyi rnam rol la 'gangs pas/ /gnyis med snying po kyai rdor la phyag 'tshal| khyab bdag mchog de'i gzhal med pho brang du/ /skal ldan dang por 'jug pa'i smin byed lam/ /rdo rje can dngos bla mar gus btud nas/ /'dir 'chad bdud sde bag yod du byos shiga'adir bcom ldan 'das dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bshad par bya ba la/lung nas ji ltar 'byung pa'i tshul dang*/ lag len ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ rgyud sde bzhi ka yang*/ gang du 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor de sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro sa chog dang sta gon sogs dang*/ der 'jug pa'i skor yan chod rnams ni rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par dang thun mong ma yin pa 'ga' re ma gtogs mtshungs pa yin te/ phal cher bya rgyud kyi gsang ba spyi rgyud nas byed pas so/ /der bzhugs pa la dbang bskur tshul la/ bya rgyud du chu dang cod pan/ spyod rgyud du de gnyis dang rdo rje dril bu ming ste/ rig pa'i dbang lnga ni rgyud de gnyis dang de thun mong ma yin la/ rnal 'byor rgyud du de lnga'i steng du dam tshig gsum byin nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang rjes gnang sogs kyi bum dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa rgyas par 'byung zhing*/ spyir dkyil chog gi bshad pa phal cher de nyid bsdus par gsungs pas na bla med phal cher gyis der kha 'phangs mdzad do/ /des na mchog dbang gsum ni bla med kyi brjod bya yin la/ der yang pha rgyud las gsang dbang gi don gzugs sku'i sgrub byed sgyu lus

rgyas par ston cing ma rgyud las gsum pa'i don chos sku'i sgrub byed bde stong rgyas pas dbang de gnyis ni pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi rim pa bzhin gtso bor ston cing*| de gnyis kar du bzhi pa'i don cung zad sbas pa rnams/ dus 'khor lta bu'i gnyis med kyi rgyud du gsal bar bstan par 'grel chen las gsungs shing de ltar don la yang legs par gnas pas na bzhi pa gtso bor ston pa de gnyis med kyi rgyud du legs par grub bo/ /de ltar rgyud 'di yang gnyis med du grub ste/ rtsa rgyud kyis de ltar ston pa'o/ /'dir kyai rdor gyi rgyud 'di nyid du dbang chog ji ltar bshad snyam na/ rtsa rgyud 'bum lnga'i brtag pa nyer gnyis pas dbang chog dngos dang*/ nyer bzhi pas sta gon rgyas par bshad la/ brtag gnyis kyi dang po'i bcu par sa sbyangs nas dkyil 'khor 'bri tshul mdor bsdus tsam gsungs nas/ gong ma bskur tshul dang*/ gnyis pa'i lnga par de gnyis bsdus pa la kha 'phangs la/ tha mar dbang bzhi bsdus nas bstan to/ gur gyi le'u gnyis pas mchod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshad dang rdul tshon gyi kha mdog tsam dang*/ sa chog gi sems bskyed rnams bstan cing*/ gsum pas gtor ma dang ming dbang la phan pa'i ming rgyas pa dang*/ bzhi pas bum dbang gi dbang chog rgyas pa dang*/ lnga par mchod pa dang lha mtshan/ bdun par dbang bzhi'i grangs| brgyad par slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ de la mchod pa dang yon 'bul tshul/ sa chog gi bka' bsgo dang sa bzung thig chog dgu par rab gnas kyi zhar la bum bskyed/ bcu gnyis par dbang gi gsol gdab dang bskur ba'i tshigs bcad/ bcu bzhi par rigs so so'i mchod rdzas dang sbyin bsreg gar stabs/ bcwa lnga par chu dbang nas shes rab ye shes kyi bar dbang dgur bsdus nas bzhi dngos su ma bshad cing mjug tu brtul zhugs lung bstan| rtsa ltung sogs kyi dam tshig rnams gsungs so/

/saṃ pu ṭi'i rab byed dang po dang*/ gsum pa'i bzhi pas/ sa chog ci rigs dang mchog dbang gsum gyi rnam gzhag bdun pa'i bzhi par rab gnas kyi zhar la sa chog gi skor ci rigs pa/ bka' bsgo rgyas pa dang bcas pa gsungs so/ /de dag la brten nas lugs 'di'i dkyil chog 'phags yul nas byon pa la/ mi thub zla ba'i bzang po yongs su bzung*/ mtsho skyes kyis nañtsa gling ma/ nag po pa'i gzhung 'grel gsum dang*/ thun mong ba la a bha yā kā ra'i rdo rje phreng ba rnams yin la/ de rnams dang bstun nas/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams dang*/ rngog lugs pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi yi ge mang du bzhugs na'ang*/ bod na legs par dar ba ni 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i rgyas pa dpal 'byung ma rnams dang*| bsdus pa jim gim ma gnyis yin la/ de gnyis ka bdag 'jug gi dbang du mdzad cing*/ de yang 'jug pa gang bde'i thabs kyis sa bslang ba dang*/ sa lha sta gon phyogs gcig pa dang*/ de bzhin du bde gshegs la sa bslang ba dang*| lha sta gon phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa rnams sogs kyi sgo nas bsdus pa yin la/ de yang spyir dbang la gang zag gzhan gyi rten 'brel sgrig pa rgyu dus kyi dbang dang*/ de yang dang yang du len pa rgyu dbang dngos lam du byed pa/ de smin nas rang gi dbang ting nge 'dzin gyi lam du byed pa/ de yang 'jug pa sogs med par dbang dngos ting nge 'dzin gyis len pa lam gyi dbang*/ sangs rgyas kyi dbang gcig car bskur ba 'bras bu mtshams sbyor gyi dbang ste lnga las dpal 'byung ma lta bu ni gsum pa'i dbang du byas par de nyid kyi mjug tu gsungs shing slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa dbang po'i yul du byed na de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dbang chu chen mo ltar bya bar gsungs pas na/ gang dag dpal 'byung ma'i cho ga tsam la brten nas slob ma la dbang bskur bar byed pa de dag ni mi 'thad la/ mngon rtogs bla ma dam pa'i yan lag drug pa dang dkyil chog de sbyor ba la yang bdag mdun mi mthun pa sogs kyi skyon yod pas/

bla ma dam pa nyid kyi gsung rgyun phyag len ji lta ba snye thang pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig g-is sdebs pa 'dug pas gong du bshad pa ltar bdag 'jug tsam byed na de bzhin du byas pas kyang 'grub mod kyi/ 'dir gtso bor rdul tshon dang sbrel zhing slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i dbang du byas nas zhar la ras bris dang bsam gtan yang rtogs shing bdag 'jug kyang 'grub pa'i rnam gzhag zhiga'aphags pa'i dbang chu chen mo dang bdag 'jug gnyis gung sgrigs nas mkhas rmongs kun la phan pa/ de yang lung rigs kyi spros pa dor nas gtso bor lag len la dril te bshad par bya'o/ / de la bzhi ste/ bskur bya dbang*/ bskur byed slob dpon/ bskur yul slob ma/ bskur thabs cho ga ste bzhi'o/ /dang po la dbang gi dgos pa/ nges tshig /dbye ba/ go rim mo/ /dang po ni/ phyi rol nyid dang nang dang ni/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu bsre ba dang*// sku bzhi'i sa bon gdab pa'i phyir/ /rgyud kun las ni dbang rab bsngags// zhes pa'o/ /nges tshig ni/ 'thor phyir dri ma sbyong pa'i phyir/ /lam la dbang phyir dngos grub kyi/ /skal pa ster phyir mchog gi ni/ /go 'phangs nyid la 'jog phyir dbang*/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ lam la sbyor bar byed pa dang*/ /kun nas goms par byed pa dang*/ /mi 'phrog pa la sbyor ba ste/ /dbang bskur rnam pa gsum yin la// rnam par phye na lnga nyid do/ / bzhi pa ni/ go rim kun nas nges pa'i phyir/ /snga ma med pa'i phyi ma min// de bas dbang bskur med par lam/ /sgrub pa lung las rnam par smad/ /zhes pa ste| phyag chen thig le'i rgyud las/ dbang med par ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu/

/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag 'dzin| |cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas/ /snying rjes slob ma rjes 'dzin pa/ / dbang bskur ba yi slob dpon mchog /ces so/ /gsum pa ni/ dad dang snying rje sems rab dul/ /rnam rtog chung zhing blo dang ldan/ /sngags kyi lam gyi mchog don gnyer/ /mthun zhing grangs dang ldan par bzung*/ /zhes sogs te/ tshigs bcad 'di 'phags pa nyid kyis mdzad par snang la/ rgyud don dang 'byor zhing 'dus pa 'dug pas 'di dag la gzhi byas nas spyi dgos kyi lung rigs dang sbyar nas spro bar gang nus bya'o/ /bzhi pa cho ga la sbyor dngos mjug gsum mo/ /dang po la sdom ni/ gsol gdab bsnyen pa sa chog dag /sta gon dang bcas rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes bya bas dang por slob mas dbang gi don du dpon slob kyi 'brel legs par brtag te/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ phyag dang maṇḍal sngon 'gro bas/ /yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas| |thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i bstan pa legs gnas pa/ /kyai rdor cho ga bshad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab cing | slob dpon gyis/ khyod kyi gus pa chen pos nus pa dang sbyar te yo byad phun sum tshogs par gyis shig dang kho bos kyang ji ltar nus pa rjes su bzung bar bya'o/ /zhes brjod nas spro na phreng pa sogs su 'byung ba bzhin slob ma bsrung ba'i cho ga bya la/ de tsam mi nus na gnas gsum du 'bru gsum bkod nas byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi bsrung 'khor gyi nang du legs par tshud par bya'o| |de nas rang nyid sngon du bsnyen pa legs par song ba yin na thugs rgyud bskul zhing gnang ba zhu ba'i ched du mchod gtor bzlas pa sogs gang 'grub tsam bya la/ ma song na mtshams bcad nas bum pa'am/ ras bris sam/ me tog tshom bu la brten nas sgrub thabs thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la brten pa'i bzlas pa la brtson par byas pas rab dngos sam/

rmi lam du lhas gnang ba dang*/ rdor dril nam mkhar 'jog nus pa dang*/ bum chu khol ba sogs rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa'am/ zla ba drug gsum la sogs par ngag phal pa dang ma 'dres par bzlas pa'i cho ga byas pas 'bring dus kyi bsnyen pa'am/ gtso bo la snying po 'bum dang*/ 'khor la khri phrag re re tshul bzhin du bzlas pa tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa ste/ de gsum gang 'grub la 'bad par bya ste/ skabs gzhan du yang ngo*| |sa chog la/ bslang ba'i skabs su/ zhing skyong dang*/ bde gshegs la slong ba gnyis ma mdzad par/ brtag pa'i skabs su bde gshegs la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ bdag skyed bsgoms nas byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ mdun skyed mchod nas bzung bar mdzad pa 'di rnams rgyud rgya gzhung gi dkyil chog che ba gang nas kyang mi 'byung zhing 'jug pa yang mi bde bar snang ba dang*/ khyad par bdag 'jug lta bu'i dus su bsdus nas byed na sa brtag pa'i gsol gdab dang lha sta gon lhan cig tu byed par gsungs pa yang sa brtag pa phyi rol du byed dgos la/ lha sta gon dkyil 'khor gyi khang par byed dgos pas na mi bde bar snang bas/ 'di dag gi go rim sogs ni gzhung che ba rnams su 'byung ba bzhin bshad par bya ste/ de nas sa chog gi sdom ni/ brtag bslang sbyong bzung byin brlabs bsrung*/ /zhes drug las/ dang po ni/ kha dog dri ro sa chu brtag /ces bya ste/ dbyibs ni/ sa phyogs zlum po'am/ gru bzhi/ shar dang byang shar du gzhol ba sogs so/ kha dog ni dkar zhing snum pa sogs so/ /dri ni tsan dan dang*| ga bur lta bu'i dri zhim po bro ba/ ro ni mngar ba dang kha dang bska ba'i ro dang ldan zhing bzang ba de lta min na ngan no/ /sas brtag pa ni/ dpus nub tsam gyi khung brus nas de brus pa'i sa de nyid kyis bkang bas lhag pa dang*/ khengs tsam dang*/ ma khengs pa rnams rab 'bring tha ma'o/ /chus brtag pa ni/ khru gang 'khor yug tsam gyi dong brus 'thas par bcags de chus bkang ste gom pa brgyar phyin nas log pa na mtho ru song ba dang*/

kha dma' ru song ba dang*/ kha thad kar gnas pa rnams rab 'bring tha ma yin la sgra dang bcas na klu'i 'jigs pa 'byung ba sogs te rgyas par gzhan du blta'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bslang ba la mngon par la bslang ba ni yul de'i bdag po la tshig gam rin gyis bslang ba'o/ /mi mngon pa la bslang ba ni/ zhing skyong sa bla bde gshegs la/ /zhes pa gsum las zhing skyong la bslang pa la/ phyogs der mchod gtor rgyas pa bshams/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par mos nas/ mchod gtor a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis lha rdzas kyi mchod gtor mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gis zhing skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas spyan drangs| oṃ kṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ā dya nutpanna twā oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa gsum dang arghaṃ/ pā tyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhre/ nai wi tye/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ dril bu dkrol zhing*/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /bdag gis sa 'di blang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ /ces lan gsum brjod la/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas rig pa 'dzin pa ci dga' bar mdzod cig ces gnang ba byin nas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ zhes brjod do/ /'dir gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlob na/ 'gron 'jig rten las 'das par bsgyur ba dang 'bul chog yang nang bzhin bya dgos te 'og rnams su yang de bzhin no/ /sa lha la blang ba ni/ spro na 'og gi sa lha sta gon bzhin bskyed chog sogs byed mod/ bsdu na mchod gtor bsham pa nas gsol gdab kyi bar snga ma bzhin la/ zhing skyong gzhi bdag ces pa'i gnas su/ sa'i lha mo zhes pa gzhug gsol gdab kyi gnas su/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir du kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i ched du sa'i phyogs 'di gnang zhing rjes su gnang bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar sogs snga ma bzhin no/ / bde gshegs las slang ba ni/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bshams nas mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis kyai'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ mngon rtogs ltar mchod khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis bstod/ gsol gdab snga ma'i bdag gi zhes pa nas/ dbang bskur bar bgyi na/ gegs med par 'grub par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin nas rang la byin gyis brlab par bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyang ba la sa sbyang ba dang*/ bgegs sbyang ba gnyis las dang po ni/ de ltar brtag shing bslang ba'i sa de rko ba na/ lto 'phye'i lus kyi rko sa min pa dang ma thug par rko bar gsungs pas/ de'i brtag thabs rgyas par phreng ba dang sā dhu pu tra'i dkyil chog sogs nas bshad pa ltar bya zhing*/ de'i man ngag spyis phyin pa kho bos gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dkyil 'khor cho ga na bris yod pas der blta zhing*/ ma grub na sa gzhi dang rko bya rko byed bde stong du mos pa brtan pos rkos pas/ rus pa dang sol ba dang gyo mo dang phub ma dang gsog ma dang shing bu la sogs pa'i zug rngu rnams bsal/ dri bzang dang sbyar ba'i rin chen lnga bdar ba'i phye ma sogs kyis sa la bsre zhing*/ grub na rkos pa'i rjes der bum gter sogs kyang gzhug go /de nyid du dkyil 'khor khang pa byed na de bzhin no/ /de ltar zug rngu dbyung ba dang sa brtag pa rnams ni dkyil 'khor khang pa dang sa stegs zur du byed na dgos kyi khang bzang dang brag steng sogs dkyil 'khor bris pas chog par ni mi dgos la/ sa slang pa yang spro na gsum ka byas kyang 'gal ba med la zhing skyong la slang ba tsam gyis kyang 'grub bo/ /de ltar na stegs legs par byas pa sogs dkyil 'khor gang du byed pa'i gzhi der|

yungs dkar dang*/ chu dang*/ sbyin bsreg gi thal ba rnams kyis brab cing bdud rtsi 'khyil pa brjod/ de bzhin du dri bzang gi chus kyang gtor te rdzas kyis sbyang ba'o/ /de nas sa gzhi lag pas mnan la/ oṃ bhū khaṃ/ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me de ni badzri bha wa badzra bandha hūm̐/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bcings te brtan par gyur/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje khro bos bgegs rnams bcom| oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra rakṣa rakṣaḥswāhā/ zhes pa rnams sngags kyis sbyar ba ste/ sngags 'di rnams kyang phal cher gur brtag saṃ gsum du 'byung ngo*/ /de rnams mig gis khro bo'i blta bas sbyang ba ni 'di'i skor du ma byung bas ma byas pas 'grub la/ sa gzhi la sogs pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur| zhes brjod cing bsam pa ni stong pas sbyang ba ste sbyang ba'i mchog yin pas| 'di legs par yid la byas na sbyang ba gzhan rnams ji bzhin ma grub na'ang rung ngo*/ /bgegs sbyang ba ni/ 'og bsrung ba'i skabs su mang pos byed pa ltar rung mod/ dbang chu chen mor 'dir bshad pas/ khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor rten dang brten pa mngon rtogs ji bzhin bsgom ste bzlas pa rdzogs pa dang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo bcu g.yon rdo rje phur bu dang g.yas rdo rje tho ba 'dzin pa phyogs bcur spros pa rnams kyis rang phyogs kyi bgegs rnams bkug nas rdo rje rwa ba'i phyi rol du gnas pa rnams kyi mgo bor phur bu rnams dus gcig tu gtsugs par mos pas/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣtaṃ phaṭa phaṭa kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la ya badzra dha rod ādzña pa ya ti kā ya wāktsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ dus gcig tu brdungs par mos shing*/

oṃ badzra mud ga ra badzra kī la ya ā ko ṭā ya ā ko ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bgegs thams cad 'od gsal gyi ngang du gnas par gyur zhes bsam zhing brjod/ spro na sngon du phur bu dang tho ba'i skyed chog sogs byas nas dngos su 'debs tshul sogs kyang gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /sbyang ba 'di dag gi thog mtha' gang mos su zhi drag gi sbyin bsreg skabs dang sbyar ba grub na'ang bya'o/ /bzhi pa bzung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir kha shar du phyogs pas sgrub grogs du yod dang bcas pas 'dug ste/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs rdzogs par bsgoms la/ slob ma gau ri la sogs pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa bzhi la sogs pa'am med na gcig gis kyang rung ste/ phyogs bzhir so sor song ba'am mi 'grub na mos te/ mchod pa byin brlabs nas/ bla ma la sgrub thabs ltar phul/ rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs kyis bstod/ nang mchod 'bul ba rnams thun mong du byas nas/ shar phyogs pas maṇḍal phul nas/ rang nyid gau rir gsal btab nas nam mkhar gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang lhan cig tu gsol ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /i daṃ gu ru ratna maṇḍal sa kaṃ ni dyā ta yā mi/ zhes pa gzhi bca' dang bcas pas dbul lo/ /de bzhin du lho pas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa= nub pas= zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung*/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog |dkyil 'khor dam pa= byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/

/kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes sogs snga ma bzhin bya la sgrub grogs med na rang gi de ltar mos par bya'o/ /de nas rang gis rdor dril dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad nas spyi gtsug tu phyogs par bzung nas/ oṃ badzra u tiṣṭha zhes brjod cing bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg par mos pa bya'o/ /de nas rkang pa mnyam pa'i stabs lag pa thal mo sbyar te nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ pra ṇa mā mi sarba ta thā ga tān zhes brjod pas phyag bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ de nyid du rdor dril 'dzin pas langs te| gur nas 'byung pa'i sems bskyed 'di dag ngag tu brjod cing legs par sems bskyed par bya ste/ sems can thams cad bsdu ba yi/ /bsdus pa'i sems can ji snyed pa/ /sgong skyes mngal nas skyes pa'am/ /drod gsher skyes dang rdzus skyes dang*/ /gzugs can rnams dang gzugs med dang*/ /'du shes can nam 'du shes med/ /med pa ma yin pa rnams so/ /nga yis sems can de rnams kun/ /phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phangs la/ /ring por mi thogs 'god par bgyi| |lan gsum brjod/ sems can ma rig pa'i mun pas bsgribs shing bdud kyi dbang du song ba rnams kyi bdud bsal ba'i phyir du rang nyid gtso bo las bye ba'i he ru ka khros pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdor dril 'dzin pa'i khro bo'i nyams thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i mig g.yas las nyi ma g.yon pa ṭaṃ las zla ba mig 'bras hūm̐ las khro bo'i rdo rje nag po dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba las 'od zer du ma phyogs bcur 'phros pas bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par gyur/ zhes bsam zhing ngag tu hūm̐ ring po drag tu brjod bzhin pas g.yas nas g.yon du bltas pas tshar bcad/ g.yon nas g.yas su bltas pas rjes su bzung bar mos la/ lus las khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bgegs rnams tshar gcod par mos pa sogs kyis sems kyi snyoms pa chen po dang rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar ba re re bsams/

rkang rjes thams cad rdo rjer gyur par mos pa dang*/ lus kyis mche ba drag tu gtsigs shing sdang mig bgrad nas rkang pas rdo rje'i 'gros dang lag pas pad skor chen po dang bcas bzhin pas ngag tu/ hūm̐ drag po brjod cing thog mar dbang ldan du song*/ de nas sa gzhi la skor ba gsum mam gcig la sogs pa byas nas/ dbang ldan nas kha nang du phyogs pas spro na khro bo spyan 'dren la sogs pa byas nas khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang mgrin gcig tu 'brug sgra chen po lta bus bka' bsgos par bsams la/ hūm̐ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan he ru ka /bka' yi 'khor lo sbyor ba po/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /lus gsum las byung gas bya ste/ /gal te kha cig nga las 'das/ /'jig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med| |gtsug gtor ram/ bgegs mthar byed kyi phreng sngags drag tu brjod/ spro na/ gsang 'dus cho ga nyi shu par 'byung ba'i bka' bsgo ring mo yang gur du 'byung bas shin tu'ang rung ngo*/ /de ltar drag sngags kyi dus su rol mo drag po bya/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs dkar gyis brab cing khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bgegs thams cad rgya ring du bskrad cing sa gzhi yang gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur zhes bsam mo/ /de nas slar yang rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang gsum pa dang lnga pa dang sna tshogs rdo rje la sogs pa'i 'gros kyis bskor zhing*/ shar lho nub byang rnams su g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang rnams su sa ga zlum po rnams kyis stang stabs dang lhan cig dpon slob kyis kha sbyor bcu drug bya'o/ /de yang slob dpon kha phyir phyogs pa'i mdun dang g.yas dang rgyab dang g.yon rnams su slob mas rim bzhin bskor nas phan tshun gyis dril bur rdo rje gzhug cing ngag tu/ oṃ kha badzra dhṛka badzra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ phaṭa/

zhes brjod do/ /stangs stabs bzhi po ni/ dang po gnyis kyi bar du mtho lnga lnga yod pa dang*/ rkang sor phyir bstan pa'i rting pa'i bar du sor gnyis yod cing pus mo bsrang ba dang*/ de nyid las pus mo gnyis khru do'i bar du gdengs pa'i ngang pa'i gshog pa ltar byas pa rnams yin la/ 'di la lag pa'i phyag rgya so so dang sems kyi nyams so sor mdzad pa'ang skabs kyi khungs yod par mi bsam na'ang spros pa la dga' na dbang chu chen mo bzhin bya'o/ /de nas drug pa bsrung pa ni/ sngags kyi bsrung 'khor thun mong ba sems kyis gsal gdab cing*| oṃ me de ni badzra bandha hūm̐/ rdo rje sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra pra ka ra hūm̐/ rdo rje'i ra ba/ oṃ badzra pañdza ra hūm̐/ rdo rje'i gur bla re/ oṃ badzra sha ra dzā la hūm̐/ mda'i dra ba/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārka hūm̐/ rdo rje'i me ri rnams rgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pas bskor bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /de nas bzung ba ni sngar brjod pa rnams kyis legs par grub bo/ /nub dang po'i sa'i cho ga'o/ / sta gon la sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ dang po la yo byad bsags pa dang*| rnal 'byor bsgom pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ dngos gzhi'i dus su dgos pa'i me tog phreng ba la sogs pa 'ga' zhig dang*/ khyad par sta gon la dgos pa'i kha dog bzang zhing drang bde ba'i rdul tshon dang*/ thig skud las thig dang ye shes kyi thig gnyis dang tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad dang*/ slob ma sta gon gyi 'o ma can gyi shing rma med cing drang ba sor bcu gnyis pa'i rtse mor me tog gis brgyan pa| bsrung skud mdom gang lhag tsam gyi be'u la sum bsgril byas pa la sngags bzlas pa'i rdo rje mdud pa gsum byas la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srad pur gyur pa la sangs rgyas kyi thugs ka nas spyan drangs pa'i ye shes kyi srad pu bstims pa dang*/

mchod pa rnam lnga'i ting lo lha bshos ku sha che chung rnams slob ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa dang*/ bum pa rgyu rin po che sogs las byas pa/ tshad dang dpangs la sor nyi shu po las mgrin pa sor drug gam brgyad/ kha'i shar nub tu sor brgyad kyi sum gnyis bug pa la yod pa/ mchu 'phyang sor gnyis pa/ rtsa ba dang nag nog med pa sogs kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ ras gtsang ma'i mgul chings phrog ma lnga'am bdun dang ldan pa srad pu dkar po bdun bdun gyis bcings pa/ bum rdzas sum cu so lnga ni/ bri ha pa ti/ bya gri /a pa ra tsi ta shu dag dkar po/ ha sa dbang lagade ba te sman lnga/ tsan dan dkar dmar/ dza ti/ gur gum/ ga pur te dri lnga/ gser dngul byi ru mu tig mu men te rin po che lnga/ nas 'bras gro sran ma til te 'bru lnga/ rtsi'i snying po dmar/ chu'i lan tshwa/ shing gi bu ram/ me tog gi sbrang rtsi/ bdud kyi 'o ma ste snying po lnga/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu rnams dang*/ rta bong gis ma bgrod pa'i chu gtsang ma rgya mtshor 'bab pa rnams las chu sna gang 'dus srog chags med pa rnams bsdus pa/ rtsa sngags dang 'khyil pa bzla zhing nyungs kar gyis brab| gu gul gyis bdug pa'i bum pa rnyed na lha grangs kyi bum pa la rang rang gi mtshan ma gdags/ gnyis las med na rnam rgyal la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ las bum la sna tshogs rdo rje btags te/ lo ma dang 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i shing gi yal ka'am/ ku sha chun pos kha brgyan la/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du dri'i chu dang bcas pa'i dung chos la gzugs thag dang ldan pa'i rdo rje dang*/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa ci 'byor gtor ma dang bcas pa bsham/ sbyin bsreg byed na de'i chos rnams dang*/ gzhan yang nang mchod rdor dril ḍā ma ru gos zung la sogs pa'i yo byad mtha' dag dgos dus brel ba med par skabs 'dir bsags la 'dzoms par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor ni/ 'dir phyi ma der byed par gsungs pa ni sa chog gi nub mo la dgongs par gsal bas der ma grub na'ang rung mod/

sta gon gyi snga dro sgrub grogs dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor byed pa'i dbus su 'dug nas sngon 'gro gtor ma rgyas par btang zhing*/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba rnams la phrin las bcol/ gcig shos rnams rgyang ring du bskrad/ gnas khang dang yo byad mtha' dag a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las byung ba'i lha'i khang bzang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las grub pa'i yo byad mtha' dag mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ khyad par mchod rdzas thams cad mngon rtogs kyi skabs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas oṃ dharma ra ṇi ta'i sngags dang bcas pa'i rol mo drag la rgyun ring bar bya zhing | de dus rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong bsrungs ma rnams sprin 'thibs pa ltar byon nas mtsho mthar ngur pa lhags pa bzhin du gnas khang gi bar snang sogs la bzhugs par bsam/ de nas sngon 'gro nas bzung ste bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs legs par bsgoms nas phyag gnyis bsdus pa nas hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pa'i lha'i nga rgyal brtan par byas/ hi hi zhes drag tu brjod pas phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bskrad par bsams nas | he ru ka'i chas drug tshang ba'am/ gang 'dzom gyi chas dang ldan par byas nas sta gon la 'jug par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor 'di dkyil chog che ba gang du yang gsal bar mi 'byung mod/ dkyil 'khor che ba rnams kyi rnal 'byor mi 'grub pas yin la dkyil 'khor 'di tsam la 'grub cing grub na legs pas bya'o/ / gnyis pa sta gon dngos gzhi la/ sa dang*/ lha dang*/ bum pa dang*| slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sa bslang ba'i gnas skabs ltar mchod gtor bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri'i thig le byas nas mthar mchod gtor byas/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la bltas te kha nub tu bltas nas nang mchod dang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/

sa gzhi bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis padma dang zla ba'i steng du baṃ las sa'i lha mo ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ rin po ches brgyan zhing dar gyi na bzas bklubs pa/ zhi ba'i ngang tshul can du gyur pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ pri thi wi de wī sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ni ri ti nas/ shabta/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi gau ri ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya zhing*/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ni ri ti nas shabta/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ sangs rgyas rnams ni/ nas/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐| zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ de la mchod pa snga ma bzhin dang gtor ma gong gi bzhin du phul nas/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// kyai'i rdo rje khros mchod pa'i/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gong bzhin gnang ba sbyin/ oṃ pri thi wi de wī badzra muḥs lha de nyid du thim pas sa'i rang bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas lha sta gon ni/ dri bzang bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i chus dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du kun tu gtor zhing skam thig thig chen brgyad tsam dgos na btab nas/ lha gnas nges par byas la| dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du zlum po byas pa'i steng du/ dri bzang gyis sbangs pa'i me tog tshom bu dbus su dgod cing*/

oṃ shrī he badzra he ru kā ya na maḥ de'i mdun du bkod nas na ma badzra nai dārmā badzra ya nā maḥde nas shar nas phyogs bzhi dang dbang ldan nas mtshams bzhir g.yas bskor du bskor cing*/ gaṃ badzra gau rī/ tsaṃ badzra tsau rī/ baṃ badzra betta lī/ ghaṃ badzra ghasma rī/ paṃ badzra pukka sā+-i/ shaṃ badzra sha wa rī/ laṃ badzra tsaṇḍa lī/ ḍaṃ badzra ḍo bhi nī ya na maḥ kun la sbyar nas dgod do/ /de nas sa gzhi dang tshom bu rnams amṛ tas bsang*| swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor skad cig gis rdzogs pa'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i dbus su/ 'byung bzhi zhes pa nas/ gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan steng du oṃ shrī he badzrā ya na maḥ zhes pa nas/ ḍom bhi ni la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs kyi mdun bskyed ji bzhin byed/ de thams cad bla ma dang ngo bo tha mi dad du byas na'ang rung la/ yang na/ gzhan yang rin po che'i khri phun sum tshogs pa'i gdan padma dang nyi zlar bcas pa'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ dri med yid du 'ong pa yi/ /zhes pa nas/ shabda/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi nas swāhā/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ zhu ba las byung pa'i lha rdzas las byung pa'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba zung du sbyar ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ srab 'jam yang ba sogs dang*/ oṃ bha ga wān badzri wasta ya swā hā| nang mchod dang gsang mchod mdun bskyed bzhin dbul/ dkar mo sogs dang*| khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs dang*/ thams cad dngos po sogs kyis bstod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ rang nyid kyi lce hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/

/mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*/ khyod la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas bka' drin mdzad par 'os/ /'gro ba 'khor ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*/ /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba dang*/ /gangs su rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /he zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir| |yo byad ci 'byor ba dag gis/ /'gro ba sbyangs phyir bdag 'bri na// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad nas su// dkyil 'khor par bcas thams cad kyis/ /thugs la dgongs nas gnang bar mdzod| |ces lan gsum gsol ba btab pas rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci dga' bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par gyur to/ /bum bskyed ni/ bum pa tshang ma yod na/ shar gyi dbang ldan dang nye bar gtso bum/ de'i dbang ldan phyogs kyi 'gram du las bum/ shar sgo'i lho ngos su yum gyi dang de'i 'gram du gau ri/ gzhan rnams rang phyogs bzhin du dgod/ gnyis las med na rnam rgyal dang de'i tshur lta'i g.yon du las bum dgod/ de nas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma ā las zla ba'i steng du/ bhruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba yangs shing mgrin pa phra ba/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan zhing*/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgrin pa dkris pa/ phyi bum pa'i dbyibs la nang thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gi rnam par gyur pa'i nang du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo/ zhes pa nas/ gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan/

las thams cad pa'i bum par paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan la a ā sogs phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i steng du ka kha sogs phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od dang bcas pa/ de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus zla ba rdo rje dang bcas pa gcig tu 'dres pas yongs su gyur pa las kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ zhes pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yum gyi mkha' ā las/ zhes pa nas/ ku ru ṣwa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas yum gyi mkhar babs thig le dgur gyur pa/ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ/ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ hūm̐ gi sa bon du gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu lha mo brgyad bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas par gyur pa rnams yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir 'thon te gdan so so'i steng du rim pa bzhin du 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau ri/ zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar bzhin| g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan zhing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug zhes pa nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje oṃ e hye hi/ zhes pa nas shapta/ gau ri ā karṣa ya/ zhes sogs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sogs nas| mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sogs nas/ dbang bskur/ sku thams cad gang*|

dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma zhes pa nas/ ḍo bi ni la 'od dpag med/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ /mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas| phyi nang gsang ba bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta u da ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdun bdun bzlas pas dung chos kyi chu ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur par mos shing brjod| de nas gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ sngags kyis lha'i thugs rgyud bskul| 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas bum chu la thim par mos shing*/ rnam rgyal la lha dgu'i sngags gang 'grub dang*/ las bum la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa| gang 'grub bzlas/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ he badzra sa pa ri wā ra/ a kā ro btags la dbul/ slar yang mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ yig brgya brjod/ ma 'byor sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha rnams chags pa chen po'i mes ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa ro gcig tu zhu ba las byung ba'-i bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam mo/

/skabs 'dir gtor ma 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams kyang sgrub thabs ltar dbul lo/ /de nas rang gi mig tu gti mug sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ bkra shis brjod/ bum pa rnams ras gtsang ma sogs kyis dgab cing spos kyi dud sprin dang bcas pas dben par bzhag go /bum pa tshang mar yod na so so'i nang du lha so so bsgom mo/ /gzhan ni 'dra'o/ / bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ sngar bshad pa'i slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa du yod khrus byas/ stan la 'khod pa la cho ga rnams rim gyis bya ste/ de la sdom ni/ kun slong bcos shing nang dbang bskur/ /gsol gdab mos pa bskyed du gzhug /sdom pa bzung zhing byin brlabs mchod/ /so shing khyor chu ku sha bsrung*| |chos bshad rmi lam rtog tu gzhug /ces pa bcu gsum mo/ /dang po ni| sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer 'ga'/ /'di na dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed| |bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/ /dad pa mang du byed pa yi// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya yi/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol 'bras mi 'byung*/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer na/ /'jig rten 'di'i 'bras bu rgyas/ /zhes dbang zhu ba la kun slong rab 'bring tha ma 'byung ba'i phyi ma gnyis spangs nas rab 'jig rten las pha rol rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang don du gnyer ba la zhugs na 'bras bu gzhan tshe 'di dang*/ phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phangs tsam yang zhar la 'grub bo/ /zhes blo nus dang sbyar nas brda sprad nas kun slong bcos par bya'o/ /nang dbang ni bla mas| rang gi snying kha nas spros pa'i 'od kyis slob ma rnams drangs/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kha'i hūṃ gi gzi brjid kyis sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rjes chags kyis thugs kar zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs/

slob ma'i grangs kyi thig ler gyur pa rnams yongs su gyur nas he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed/ ye shes pa bcug dbang bskur nas yum gyi mkha' nas bton te rang gnas su dgod pa'o/ /'di ni rdo rje theg pa'i gtso bo bla med kyi rten 'brel sgrig pa'i thog ma yin la/ mdo rgyud gzhan kun la yang dpon slob pha bu'i 'brel pa rjes mthun pa yod mod kyi/ 'di ni mtshan nyid tshang ba yin te/ de'i phyir 'di la dkyil chog khungs thub rnams su bur bya ba zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa ni shin du legs so/ /de nas slob mas maṇḍal legs par phul/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang du mos pas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ bdag med ma dang lhan cig sbyor/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa te/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'debs su gzhug go /sngags la mos pa brtan po 'dzin du gzhug pa ni/ slob ma gcig gtso bor byas pa'am/ kun la thun mong du brjod kyang rung ste/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /tshul chen snod ni khyod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes| |gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gi shākya seng ge sogs// mchog rnams kyis kyang bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/

/bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces gsungs pa'i don/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje theg pas sangs rgyas pas na sangs rgyas 'dod phyin chad lam 'di nges par brten dgos so/ /zhes brjod do/ /sdom pa bzung ba ni/ dbang rdzogs par nod pa la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig mtha' dag bzung dgos lugs dang bzung rgyu 'di dang 'di'o/ /zhes pa'i sdom pa bsgrags pa sngon du btang na rab/ de ltar min na'ang sdom bzung gi don cung zad bshad nas/ don dran bzhin pas lha dang bla ma dpang por bzhag pa'i tshul gyis/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi| |zhes sogs thun mong gi sdom pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa rigs lnga'i sdom bzung sgo gsum dag pas lan gsum byed du gzhug de ltar byas pas slob dpon rtsa ltung dang mi ldan na 'dir sdom pa skye la/ ldan na sang bdag 'jug gis dag nas dngos gzhi'i dus su skye ba'i smin byed du 'gyur ro/ /byin brlabs ni/ rtsa sngags bzlas pas slob ma'i sdig pa sbyangs/ slob ma he ru kar gsal ba'i dpral mgrin snying kha rnams su rim pa bzhin 'khor lo/ padma/ rdo rje rnams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ rnams dkar dmar sngo ba bsgom du bcug la/ rang gi dri bzang gis chus slob ma'i gnas de rnams su reg nas 'bru gsum brjod pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /mchod pa ni/ de ltar slob ma rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa ni/ bla mas kyang mchod 'os pas/ mchod yon sogs kyi mchod pa slob ma'i grangs mnyam mam gang 'byor gyis re re zhing mchod par bya'o/ /so shing ni slob dpon gyi mdun du ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i maṇḍal khru gang pa sogs byas pa'i me tog tshom bu dgu pa dbus ma che ba byas/ slob ma kha byang du phyogs pa'i lag tu so shing*/

oṃ dzi ha badzra saṃ bha ra ḍā ni hūm̐ zhes brjod nas gtad la/ slob mas thal mo sbyar bas bzung ste/ so drud la sdig pa skyug par bsam zhing me tog tshom bu'i steng du dor ba'i rtse mo shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir bstan na rim pa bzhin zhi rgyas dbang drag mtshams su dngos grub phra mo/ steng 'og bla ma rnams la bstan na/ mkha' spyod sa 'og mchog rnams 'grub par lung bstan no/ khyor chu ni/ las bum gyi chu la oṃ hrīḥbi shudhāḥsarba dharmā sarba pā pa ni tse a sya bi shuddhā sarba pi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐ zhes brjod de blugs pas sdig pa sbyang ngo*/ /ku sha ni/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yon par ku sha chung ba dhi dang*| g.yas par che ba hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sbyin no/ /bsrung skud ni/ slob ma skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas par rtsa sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i yig brgya brjod cing bcings pas bar chad bsrung ngo*/ /chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten na ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don| |bla med byed par nus ma yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du mar ni/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos| |skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phangs bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang zhig spyod pa'i mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par/

/bdag nyid chen po khyed gnas te/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du| |sang ni nges par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang 'byung skal pa chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bshad la spro ba bskyed/ de lta na ku sha che ba bstan dang chung pa rngas su gyis/ mgo shar ram byang du bstan no/ /gzhogs g.yas pa 'ogatu chug lha dang bla ma la dad pa chen pos gsol ba thob la do nub rmi lam legs par bzung nas bzang ngan sang smra rgyu yod par gyis shig ces brjod nas rang gnas su btang ngo*/ /sta gon gyi mjug chog ni/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod gsol ba btab nas yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas la/ sa chog gi skabs ltar nam mkhar btegs pa slar yang mchod bstod bsdus pa byas/ tshom bu bsdus nas las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ gtor 'gron gshegs/ rang gis skye mched dang gnas gsum sngar bzhin bsrungs la nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal lo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni bya ba dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang dang*/ /slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba/ /dngos gzhi'i yan lag rnams pa gsum/ /dang po la/ dkyil 'khor 'bri dang rgyan dgram dang*/ /yo byad bsag dang bdag bskyed bsgom/ /bsgrub dang mchod pa rnam pa drug /de'i dang po la/ thig tshon byin brlabs las thig gdab/ /ye thig gis mnan tshon dgye dang*/ /mtshan ma dgod dang bum pa dbul/ /zhes pa drug las/ dang po ni/ spyir dkyil 'khor gyi tshad dang 'byor pa dang bstun pas nges pa med kyang byung tshad kyis rtsa thig khru gang gis tshad las chung ba mi rung bas so/ /thig skud ras bal sogs las gzhon nu ma 'am dam tshig can gyis bkal ba'i srad bu dkyil 'khor rtsa thig gi sum 'gyur gyi srid dang*/

sgo'i nyi shu cha'i sbom phra'i tshad dang ldan pa kha dog dkar po gcig dang*/ kha dog re re la yang lnga bsgril du byas pa rnams sdoms te sgril tshad snga ma dang ldan pa'i kha dog lnga pa rnams dang*/ tshon sna lnga la rin po che dang rus pa'i phye ma bsres/ sngo dkar ser dmar ljang ba rnams dbus shar lho nub byang du bkod pa la/ hūm̐ bruṃ aṃ dziṃ khaṃ rnams rim bzhin bris| tshon gyi steng du thig skud rnams kha dog so sor bzhag mchod par bsham/ thig tshon nang mchod kyis bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las dbus dang phyogs bzhir ā li kā li las zla ba kha sbyar lnga'i dbus su hūm̐ bruṃ aṃ dziṃ khaṃ rnams las zla ba kha sbyar dang bcas pa las skyes pa'i rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che padma ral gri rnams hūm̐ sogs lngas mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa rnam snang rin 'byung*| 'od dpag med don grub rnams sngo dkar ser dmar ljang ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas rdo rje sogs lnga dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas rang gi yum la 'khyud pa rnams kyis gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ rang gi mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi zla dang mig 'bras hūm̐ du gyur/ rdzi ma 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyi gyen du bltas pas sta gon gyi rigs lnga'i thugs kha nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba spyan drangs pa rnams gnyis su med par thim/ sngar bzhin dbang bskur/ rdor sems kyis dbu brgyan pa la/ phyi nang gis mchod| mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs pa ā ka ros dbul/ rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par gzhugs pa'i sgra dang*| rang gi mig gi rdzi ma brdabs pas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs pa rigs lnga'i zhal nas zhugs thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu zhing*/ bde ba chen po'i mes yab yum bcu'ang zhu ba las ye shes kyi thig tshon lnga'i ngo bor gyur par bsam zhing*/

'bru gsum dang*/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐ nyer gcig brjod nas thig tshon lag pas mnye zhing sngags brjod do/ /las thig gi cha dbye ba ni/ rang nyid lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /bstar zhing yid 'ong sa gzhi la/ /srad bu dkar po thig chal bcas/ /shar dang nub kyi dbus thad la/ /tshangs thig dang po gdab par bya/ /mtha' ru du khrod sa bzhag la| |dkyil 'khor phyed rtags dbus su dgod/ /de yi shar nub phyed nas ni// rtags dgod steng la mnan brkyang pa'i/ /srad bus lho byang bya rjes btsal/ /de steng lho byang tshangs thig gdab/ /de la dkyil 'khor phyed rtags gdab// dkyil 'khor phyed tshad srad pu des/ /shar sogs rtags kyi steng nas mnan// shar lho la sogs mtshams bzhir brkyang*/ /de ltar g.yas bskor g.yon bskor gnyis| |byas pas mtshams bzhir bya rjes 'byung*/ /de steng ngos kyi thig bzhi dang*| |zur gyi thig bzhi gdab par bya/ /zur thig bzhi po'i nag ngos su// sum gnyis dor bya bya rjes btsal/ /thig bzhi btab pa rtsa thig yin/ /de'i dbus su brgyad cha bgo /sgo de yi bzhi cha chung yin/ /de nas thig thung 'debs 'dod na/ /phreng bar gsungs pa ji bzhin bya/ /skam thig byed na 'di lta ste// ngos thig de gnyis phyed mar gshags/ /phyi ma phyed gshags de phyi yang*/ /nang ma'i phyed ma dkyil du bzhag /ngos thig phyi ma'i phyi rol nas/ /sgo tshad gsum du so sor btub/ /gsum pa'i sa nas g.yas g.yon du/ sgo tshad gnyis mthar bya rjes bya/ /de steng thig ring snol mar gdab/ /ngos thig phyi ma'i steng nas ni/ /de nang phyed gshags de yang gshags/ /nang ma ma gtogs de yang gshags/ /rta babs 'phred la'ang gsum gshags bya/ /thog mtha' gnyis po bzhi bzhir btub| |bar ma'i bzhi cha dbus su bzhag /nang ma'i thig bzhi che chung rer// g.yas g.yon so sor phyir la bkyed/ /phyi ma'i thig lnga de bzhin bskum/ /lnga pa slar yang gnyis gnyis bskum/

/mun snam gnyis po'i steng thig nas/ /re re nang du dor bar ni/ /drang po'i thig gi ka ba bya/ /nang du glang rgyab tshul bzhin bskor| |dgos pa'i thig kun rlon pas mnan/ /mi dgos pa rnams phyi bar bya| |de dag mkhas pa'i ngag las shes/ /de nas dbus su phur bu gtsugs// de la skor thig btags nas ni/ /rtsa ba'i nang dang gcig dang bcu/ /dor bar zlum thig gsum bya ste/ /padma 'dab brgyad legs par bri/ /rta babs rtse nas bzhi dang gnyis/ /bzhi gnyis bzhi mthar zlum thig bskor/ /rdo rje'i rwa yang man ngag bzhin/ /bskor bas las thig rnam par dag /de nas phur bu tshul bzhin dbyung*/ /zhes pa rnams man ngag dang sbyar nas rtogs par bya'o/ /de la slob dpon gyis tshon sna lnga'i thig skud rnams blangs te langs pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar du bltas la g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis thig sna bzung*/ slob mas skad cig gis gau rir bskyed pa'i lag tu gtad pa gnyis kar gyis dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod/ lnga kar lhan cig tu legs par bsgril zhing de'i tshe gnyis kas| oṃ a n+yo sogs sam/ de'i bod skad/ phan tshun rjes su rtogs pa ste// chos kun phan tshun rjes su 'gro/ /chos rnams thams cad shin tu yang*/ /kun du 'gro bar chos kun brjod/ /ces dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med pas kyang brjod| de nas slob dpon shar dang lhor gnas pas/

/tshangs thig gnyis gdab mer gnas pas/ /shar lho'i rtsa thig zur bcas gdab/ /bden bral gnas pas zur gcig gdab/ /kun tu slob ma mdun phyogs pas/ /skor tshe bla mar rgyab mi bstan/ /zhes bya ste thig chen brgyad po de 'debs pa na slob dpon gyis mtheb mdzub kyis nam mkha' la thig gdab cig de'i sgras sangs rgyas thams cad 'gro don gyis/ /dus yin de phyir 'dir byon cig /zhes pa'i sgras bskul bas sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ngo bo ye shes la rnam pa srad bu kha dog lnga pa re chad nas thig la thim par bsam zhing 'og tu'ang btab la/ gnyis kar gyis chod/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes brjod cing gdab bo// de bzhin du thig lhag ma rnams nam mkhar 'debs pa ma grub na'ang sa re re zhing gdab/ de tsam ma grub na/ tshangs th-ig gnyis la nam mkhar 'debs par bya| gzhan rnams sa nyid la gdab bo/ /de ltar thebs nas thig skud gnyis la mchod pa bsdus pa bya/ ye shes pa sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs/ srad pu gnas ji lta bar gzhag grub na sa la gdab pa'i thig la mchod par bya/ oṃ badzra be ga kra ma ho/ zhes pa'i sngags rgyas ye thig la 'dzul nas/ dbus su song zhing rdo rje dril bu gar bskor zhing*/ 'gying ba dang bcas pas dku gnyis su brten pa khro bo'i lta bas hi hi zhes brjod cing*/ sgo thig bzhi po dri bzang gi chus phyis la thar pa'i sgo'i gegs su gyur pa'i sgrib pa rnams dbyi bar bya'o/ /zhes brjod de/ mjug tu dril bu gnas brgyad du dkrol zhing ra ṇi ta'i sngags brjod do| |de nas slob dpon gyis rdul tshon rnams la oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma hūm̐/ zhes pas sngags g.yon pa rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis dbang ldan nas brtsams te/ rtsig pa nang nas rim pa bzhin nag ljang dmar ser dkar ba lnga sgo'i nyi shu cha sbom phra dang yo ba dang chad pa la sogs med pa ci tsam nus pa zhig g.yas bskor du 'bri zhing de'i tshe/

chos dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab grol byed/ /kyai rdo rje rgya chen gyi/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa 'bri bar bya| |zhes pa ye shes lnga la sbyar nas dbyangs dang bcas pa sogs kyis brjod do| |tshon pra brtag pa ni mkhas pa rnams mi bzhed pas mi bya'o/ /de nas slob mas 'bri ba ni/ dbus kyi sna tshogs padma la/ /phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser| |bden bral ljang la dbang ldan sngo/ /lte ba ljang khu ge sar ser/ /lte bar nyi gdan dmar por bri/ /phyogs mdog mngon rtogs ji bzhin te/ /grwa bzhir bum pa gnyis gnyis bri/ /rtsig pa 'khor na mtshan ma ni/ /thod dkar sna tshogs rdo rje yis/ /mtshan dang gri gug dbus su bri/ /shar nas phyogs bzhir gri gug dang*| |phag dang rus sbal sbrul rnams bri/ /dbang ldan nas brtsams mtshams bzhir ni/ /seng ge dge slong 'khor lo dang*/ /rdo rje rnams ni bri bar bya/ /'dod yon dmar po lha mo dkar// pha gu ser po rin chen phra/ /drwa ba'i gzhi ni nag po la| |drwa ba drwa phyed sna tshogs mdog /mda' yab khra bo pu shu ser/ /ka ba ser po glang seng brgyan/ /ka rgyan me tog chun 'phyang ldan/ /rta babs snam bu rang ming la| kha dog gsal ba de der bri/ /mi gsal mdzes tshon rdo rje'i rwa/ /phyogs mdog padma'i lte ba ljang*// ge sar ser po 'dab ma rnams/ /sna tshogs ji ltar mdzes par bya/ /dur khrod sa gzhi nag po la/ /der gnas rang rang mdog tu bri| |rdo rje 'od phreng bzhi nag po/ /rdo rje dkar raṃ ser po dang*/ /me ri sna tshogs mdog tu bya/ /tshon lhag la yang thig bzhin bya/ /de nas bum pa dbul ba ni/ /bum pa rnams blangs la gong du bshad pa'i phyogs de dang der bzhag dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la ba byung dang dri bzang byugs/ mchod pas bskor/ bum pa 'god dus lha so so'i sngags brjod cing dbul bar bsam mo/ /rgyan dgram pa ni/ bla re rgyan sogs ci 'byor pas phyi nang kun du brgyan/

'dzin gtor du dgos dang nang mchod rdor dril sogs kyang bla ma'i mdun du legs par bsham mo/ /yo byad bsags pa ni/ mig dar rdor dril dbu rgyan mda' gzhu po ti me long phyag mtshan/ khrus stegs sogs gang dgos tshogs par byed pa'o| | bdag bskyed bsgom pa ni/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nas bzung ste mngon rtogs rgyas pa bsnyen bsgrub tshang bar bsgom pa'o/ / dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ni/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs mngon rtogs ltar byas| las bum gyi chu dang a mṛ tas dkyil 'khor bsangs swa bha was stong par sbyangs| stong pa'i ngang paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ zhu ba las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas/ bsrung pa'i 'khor lo rgya che ba'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las me'i/ baṃ las chu'i/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ bhruṃ las 'khor lo bhruṃ gyis mtshan pa rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ zhes pa nas rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur| de'i phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad/ zhes pa nas gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin bsdus pa'am/ bdag bskyed bzhin rgyas par gang rung bya| dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du a ā zhes pa nas/ ku ru ṣā me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra/ ha ha si si kun dhu ru badzra dhṛ ka zhes pa nas| ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ji bzhin bya/ de nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bdag bskyed kyi dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor lha la lha dang dkyil 'khor la dkyil 'khor dbyer med du gyur/ oṃ pad ma zhes pa nas ku ru ṣwa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra/ zhes pa nas/ yum gyi mkhar babs/ thig le de yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gtso bo yab yum las gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dang rnam shes kyi phung po sbyangs chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang gtso bo yab yum gyi go 'phangs la bkod/ tshur 'dus gtso bo yab yum la thim/ gau rī las gau ri dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang gau ri'i go 'phangs la bkod/ tshur 'dus gau ri la thim/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ tsau ri la/ ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po| mnyam nyid ye shes/ betta lī dang*/ 'dod chags dang 'du shes/ so sor rtog pa/ ghasma rī las phrag dog dang 'du shes/ bya ba grub pa/ pukka sogs bzhi las/ sa khams dang byams pa tshad med/ chu khams dang snying rje/ me dang dga' ba/ rlung dang btang snyoms sbyar| gzhal yas khang las gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa 'phros ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin du gyur/ lam byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo rnam par dag par byas/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad lhar gyur pa rnams de'i nang du 'khod/ tshur 'dus gzhal yas khang la thim/ dur khrod las dur khrod dpag tu med pa 'phros| 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rnam rtog sbyangs/ chos brgyad mgo snyoms/ 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs pa'i go 'phangs la bkod/ tshur 'dus dur khrod brgyad la thim/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar byas| tshur 'dus bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ lha thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug nas thugs khar thugs rdo rje ma/ de nas bgegs mi 'jug pa'i phyir du aṣta tshar bdun brjod/ rol mo drag tu bya/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor ye shes pa dang bcas pa spyan drangs bsrung

'khor cung zad kha bye ba'i nang na bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ oṃ e hye hi bha ga wān/ zhes pa nas/ gau rī ā kārṣa ya dzaḥ sogs brjod| slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyi rang bzhin gyis gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ e hye hi nas/ he badzra sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ mchod bstod/ sngar bzhin dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ mchod bstod/ gsol gdab sogs bdag bskyed bzhin byas pas| 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar bya'o/ /bsrung 'khor kha bcad nas bgegs rnams kyis mi phyed par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa| ces brjod do/ /de nas oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ zhes sogs kyis yig brgya tshar gcig dang*/ he ru ka'i gnas su/ nai rātma/ gau rī/ tsau rī/ betta lī| ghasma rī/ pukka sī/ tsaṇḍa lī/ ḍo bi nī rnams kyi mgor badzra cis kyang sbyar zhing | naṃ dang gaṃ sogs kyi sa bon sbyor na'ang rung ba'i yi ge brgya pa tshar re nas mdun bskyed byin gyis brlab bo/ /gzhan yang rin po che'i khri phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas skor ba rnams kyang badzra sa mā dzaḥ ratna padma tsand+ra ā pa na tiṣthantu swāhā/ de nas mchod pa byin brlabs skabs 'dir spro na'ang byas la/ mngon rtogs kyi mdun bskyed bzhin dang mchod phreng nas 'byung ba bzhin rgyas par byas nas/ nang du gtor ma ji tsam spro ba legs par btang*/ sgrub grogs zhig rtsa sngags 'don cing dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug nas/ phyi rol du song ste/ gtor ma rdo rje gsum dang mgron brgyad tshan gsum po la mngon rtogs ji bzhin phul/ rdo rje'i glu dang smon lam bkra shis brjod/

oṃ hrīḥbi shungnghaḥsarba dha rmā sarbapā paṃ ni tsa a sogs / bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐/ ces pas 'thor 'thung byin| oṃ sarba bhū ta gatstsha zhes pas nag phyogs rgyang ring du bskrad/ dkar phyogs rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas rtsa sngags dang yig brgya brjod cing nang du 'ongs nas/ slob dpon a bha yas bshad pa ltar hūm̐ mdzad kyis nga rgyal dang bcas pas rdo rje shugs kyi sngags rgya dang bcas pa'am/ ma grub na yid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi nang du rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs la bskor bar mos bzhin du yig brgya brjod ba'i bskor ba gsum la sogs pa byas nas/ lhag chad zhi ba'i phyir du ma 'byor ba dang zhes sogs kyi bzod gsol bya/ yang na bde mchog sogs su 'byung ba ltar/ me tog gi phreng ba blangs la/ gar bskor bzhin pa'i glu dang bcas pas/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol bar ldan| |sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcos ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥhi hi hi hi| mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ /zhes pa'am/ de'i rgya skad oṃ pa ra ma su kha sogs kyis gtso bo la me tog phul/ nang nas sgo phye bar mos shing*| hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'grol bzhin oṃ badzra udgha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes shar sgo nub nas 'byed pa sogs rgyas par bya ba'am ma grub na yid kyis bya| sa ma ya pra be sha ya mi/ zhes pas me tog blangs pas mgo la bcings/ oṃ pra ṇa ma mi sarba ta thā ga tā na/ zhes pas phyag rgya byas la sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin bstsal du gsol zhes brjod/ sbyin bsreg grub na'ang skabs 'dir bya'o/ /de dag ni rgyas pa'i rnam gzhag yin la/ sa gzhi sngar nas sbyangs par bdag 'jug tsam byed na/ zhing skyong la blang ba tsam byas pa'i rjes su rdzas sngags stong pas sbyangs/ bdag bskyed man chod kyi bsrung ba la sogs pa rnams tshang bar byas/

sta gon rnams las slob ma sta gon ma gtogs tshang bar bya zhing*/ ras bris byed na'ang de dang 'dra ba las thig tshon gyi skor rnams bzhag go gnyis pa bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ dbang chog thams cad slob ma la dbang bskur tshul du sbyar nas bdag 'jug la 'og nas 'chad pa ltar slang zhes kha 'phangs pa mang na'ang*/ 'dir bdag 'jug la sbyar nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin tshul thun mong ma yin pa dgos su bshad na 'phral du phan che bar snang bas de ltar bshad par bya'o/ /de la gnyis/ 'jug pa dang*/ dbang blang ba'o| |dang po la/ gdong g.yogs dang bcas te dang*/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid du 'jug pa'o/ dang po la phyi 'jug dang nang 'jug go /dang po ni| bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pas rang la phyi 'jug mdzad pa'i ched du yol ba'i phyi rol du byon par mos nas/ rang nyid khrus byas maṇḍal phul/ gsol btab dang*/ sdom bzung gnyis po sta gon ltar byas/ oṃ tsakṣu ban dha wa ra ma ṇā ya hūm̐ dang*/ oṃ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis mig dar bcings me tog gi phreng ba gtad par mos pas blang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum chu de'i sngags bzlas pas rang nyid bsang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi lce la bzhag 'dir rang nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bskyed pa'i sgo gsum byin gyis brlab par gsungs mod/ rnam snang du bskyed pa lung rigs dang mthun pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rnam snang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin par gyur pa'i dpral bar 'khor lo la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma la āḥdamar po/ snying khar rdo rje la hūm̐ sngon po/ de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis lus gsal bar byas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ kye khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lan gdab pa'i bsam pas/ skal bzang bdag ni bde chen la'o| |de yis khyod la ci zhig bya zhes gsungs pa la/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes brjod pas rigs dang mos pa shes par byas/

dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad byang chub kyi sems gnyis su 'dus pas de'i rnam pa lam du bya ba'i phyir du/ rang gi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa| oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa ta yā mi/ oṃ su ra ta sa ma ya st+waṃ ho/ siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ deng khyed de bzhin gshegs pa dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di dkyil 'khor du ma bzhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing sngags dang po rang gis thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed snyam pas brjod cing gzhan rnams bla mas brjod/ dzaḥsogs kyi gau rī sogs bzhis dkyil 'khor gyi nang du bcug par bsam zhing dngos su yol ba'i nang du zhugs pa yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor la sgo gsum gus pas phyag byed par mos shing na maḥte hūm̐/ na ma mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐ zhes brjod do/ /de nas bla mas dam bzhag par mos te*/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub rnams kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ ngas de lta bu'i rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis khyod kyis kyang dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag bzhugs par 'gyur/ /gal te tshul 'dir smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs| |'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje ste/ gal te khyod kyis tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/

/dam tshig 'das na bsreg pa byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ pañtsa amṛ ta u da kaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥhūm̐/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di byos zhig bya ba de khyod kyi bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por lhung bar gyur ta re/ de rnams dam bzhag bzhi ru bsdus nas/ phan yon dang nyes dmigs dang*/ gnyis ka dang*/ slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa zhes gsungs mod kyi/ phan yon dang gnyis ka dang*/ nyes dmigs dang*| de rdo rje'i gnas brtan par bya ba dang tha ma ste lnga 'chad pa legs so/ /de nas ye shes dbab pa'i phyir du spro na maṇḍal dbul zhing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig

dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol| lan gsum brjod chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang las rang nyid he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyi bzhengs pa'i rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can 'chang bzung thur du bstan pa/ chog ma gnyis kyi steng du rkang pa'i mthil du dzhaiṃ me'i rang bzhin drag cing bzod par dka' ba/ sum mdor raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po as mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon zla gam has mtshan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og gi rlung bskyod/ rlung gis me sbar/ me rkang pa'i nang nas zhugs te song ba dang*/ sum mdor 'dres te lus thams cad gang pas nad dang bgegs dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsregs/ snying kha'i sa bsregs| mgrin pa'i chu khol/ spyi bo'i rlung gis mnan/ rkang 'og gi rlung gis bteg phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad char chen po bab pa bzhin babs nas lus la zhugs pas/ lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ aṣta/ sogs dang*/ oṃ tiṣṭha ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya rgya dpe la sto bha ya zer ba 'dug stambha ya stambha ya ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsā la ya hūm̐ āḥhaḥdzhaiḥ lan bdun nam gsum/ spogs chog ni/ slob mar rang gi spyi bor bla ma he ru ka'i ngo bor gsal bar bzhugs pa rang gi spyi bo nas thim pa dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur par mos/ bla mas rtsa sngags drag tu brjod/ de ltar dbab pas phebs pa'i rtags lus 'bar ba dang*/ ngag saṃ skṛ ta'i skad smra ba dang*/

yid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes pa sogs rgyas par gzhan du bshad pa ltar 'byung zhing dus gsum gyi mngon shes smra ba sogs byung na'ang cho ga bzhin du bri bar bya la rnam 'gyur ma zhi na gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de lta min na spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du byas nas tiṣṭha badzra zhes brtan par bya/ de nas bla mas slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir du/ hūm̐ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog |snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs 'di gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces brjod de dril bu bsil lo/ /de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du langs pa dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi kha dog ltar gzhug cing*/ dkar ser dmar nag ljang khu mthong na zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las sna tshogs su 'grub par lung bstan no/ /de nas 'greng ste 'dud pa dang bcas pas me tog snyim par bzung ste/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa nas bdag dgyes mdzod/ /lan gsum/ de nas/ bla mas dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir lha dgu bzhugs thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul yin pas ngo bo la bzang ngan gang yang med mod/ kun kyang rigs lngar 'dus pas khyed rang gi rigs bdag gang yin pa dang*/ 'brel ba yod pa de'i dbu la 'bab par gyur cig snyam pa'i mos pas ltos med du dor shig ces brjod| oṃ pra tītstsha badzra ho/ zhes brjod cing dor nas gang la phog pa'i lha ngo shes par byas/ bla mas me tog blangs nas slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la oṃ pra ti gṛhna st+waṃ i maṃ patra mahā ba la/ zhes pas me tog phog pa'i lha la sems dpa' stobs po che zhes bos nas slob ma 'di byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rjes su zung zhig

ces gtad cing dbang dang po me tog phreng ba'i dbang bskur ro/ /'di ni sngags don dang yo ga'i 'grel pa tshad thub kyi dgongs pa yin pas 'di ltar bya'i/ lha des slob ma la byin par mos pa byas na/ dbang 'di bla ma la ma thob kyi bar yang 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni rang gi mig gnyis su oṃ 'od zer 'bar ba re re oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med| |he badzra pā shya/ zhes brjod pas bla mas mig dar bsal/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /me tog gang du lhung gyur pa/ /de ni khyod kyi he ru ka /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/ /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin thar pa chen po'i khang bzang mthong ba tsam gyis sdig pa mtha' dag zad par byed pa de nyid rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar gyur to/ /snyam pa slob mas bya zhing*/ bla mas rten phyi nas dang brten pa nang nas rdzogs par bstan zhing*/ de kho na nyid 'dir mi bstan no/ /de nas slob ma gral la 'khod nas dga' zhing spro bas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod de| |oṃ rdo rje dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so// rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yis/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong*| |gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya hoḥhoḥhoḥzhes brjod do/ / gnyis pa zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba la/ bum pa/ gsang ba/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa bskur ba'o/ /dang po la sbyor dngos mjug gsum mo/

/dang po ni bla ma sprul sku'i rnam pa can la bum dbang gi yon du maṇḍal dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes maṇḍal phul/ thal mo sbyar bas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /de nas dbang stegs la bkod nas mi shes pa sbyang zhing shes par bya ba ni/ rang dang dbang stegs bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du rin po che'i khri padma nyi mar bcas pa'i gdan la rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan/ phyogs kun tu mchod pa thams cad kyis gang bar gyur/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pa gcig gis rang gi sdig pa thams cad til la bstims nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang du bsregs par gyur/ oṃ badzra ḍa ka kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swāhā/ phyi nang gi dri ma dag pa'i chus dkrus shing sbyangs par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing til mer bsregs nas g.yas su dang*/ khu tshur gyis chu g.yon du dor/ oṃ hrīḥbi shungnghā nas/ a pa na ya hūm̐/ rang nyid 'khor dang bcas pa'i byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing dri bzang gi chu btung ngo*/ /gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pas bdag la bkra shis kyi cho ga mdzad par gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum dang nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod/ slob ma la bskur na las kyi rdo rjes rol mo bcas dbyangs la sogs pa brjod do/ / gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ 'dir bum dbang gi sdom ni chu dang cod pan rdor dril ming*/ /brtul zhugs slob dpon de nyid bstan/

/rjes gnang lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs| |bcu gcig bum pa'i dbang yin no/ /zhes bya la/ bsdu na thun mong pa rdo rje slob ma'i dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang du 'du bas| dang po la/ lnga las/ chu'i dbang ni/ dpon slob gnyis dbang rdzas dang gsum ka lhar skyed par yang bshad la/ bla ma dang gtso bo'i nga rgyal nyid las gzhan gnyis lhar bskyed par yang bshad pas/ 'dir phyi ma ltar bya zhing*/ 'dir nam mkha'i dbang lha spyan 'dren lan gcig las ma mdzad kyang a bha yas dbang re re zhing spyan drangs nas bstim pa dang*/ bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor pas dgongs pa gtad| de'i gtso bo dang tha mi dad pa'i bla mas dbang gi bya ba thams cad mdzad pas der dbang thob par 'jog par bshad pa'i don du dran bzhin pas/ thog mar bum chu rnams bsdus/ rang dang bum chu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang dang dbang rdzas bum chu gnyis padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka mi skyod pa kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa phyag g.yas pa brgyad kyis rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pa brgyad kyis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang sku mdog sngon po rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ gnyis ka'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ zhes pa nas thugs khar thugs rdo rje ma/ bsdu na gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mi skyod pa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥs mchod/ gau ri ā karṣa ya dzaḥ/ sogs bzhi brjod| bsdu na mchod pa med par dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi skyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur pa la mchod/ mi skyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas bum pa'i chur gyur/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu nas rigs lnga yab yum 'khor bcas dpag tu med pa badzra sa mā dzas mchod/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de ltar 'di la stsal du gsol zhes bla mas gsol ba btab pas nam mkha'i rigs lnga dang sgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis dgongs pa mdzad/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i yum rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas dbang bskur rig ma rnams kyis me tog gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs shing rdo rje'i glu len/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo khro mo rnams dang ma mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad| mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi sogs nas/ oṃ badzri bha wa abhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas bum pa'i chus rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag bde ba chen po myong*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i dbang lha thams cad kyang rang gi ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ ni ri ti sogs kyis mchod/ 'di rnams kyi bum chu btung ba dang spyi bor gtor zhing bkru bar bya'o/ /de nas bla mas dbang don bshad pa ni/ de dag gis mi skyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob| zhe sdang gi dri ma dag

rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mi skyod pa'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag cing de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ /zhes brjod do/ /de ltar chu dbang gi skor la nges pa legs par rnyed pa'i sgo nas dag 'don byang par byas nas rig pa'i dbang lhag ma la 'don pa spo bar bya'o/ / gnyis pa cod pan ni/ snga ma ji bzhin sbyang zhing*/ khyad par bum pa'i gnas su cod pan/ mi bskyod pa dang mā ma ki'i gnas su rin 'byung dang sgrol ma ser mo zhes brjod pas dbu rgyan dang dar dpyang bcings*/ de rjes bum pa'i chus kyang*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs snga ma j-i bzhin dbang bskur nas dbang don yan chad 'dra ba la/ nga rgya dang ser sna/ tshor ba'i phung po/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ zhes pa 'don pa spo'o/ gsum pa rdo rje ni/ 'don pa rdo rje la spo/ badzri las padma zhes sbyar zhing*/ 'od dpag med dang gos dkar mo dmar mor brjod/ dbang dngos la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya| |sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long*/ / oṃ ma hā badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ chu dbang yan chad snga ma ji bzhin 'don pa spo zhing*/ 'dod chags/ 'du shes/ so sor rtog pa'i zhes sogs sbyar ro/ /bzhi pa dril bu ni/ 'don pa dril bu la spo/ khaṃ las ral gri zhes sbyar zhing*/ don grub dang dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu sbyar/ dbang dngos la/ rdo rje'i skabs kyi rdo rje'i gnas su dril bu bcug sngags oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+wāṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi ti tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya st+wāṃ brjod/ 'dir dril bu lag pa g.yon dang*/ snga mar rdo rje g.yas su gtad/ chu dbang man chad 'dra ba la/ phrag dog 'du byed/ bya ba grub pa zhes sbyar ro/ /lnga pa ming la/ dbang rdzas med pas/ bdag nyid bsang sbyangs/

bruṃ las 'khor lo sbyang zhing*/ rnam snang dang spyan ma dkar mo brjod/ dbang dngos la/ oṃ badzra satwa st+wāṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka taḥ kyai dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing*/ rdor dril gnyis lag pa g.yas su bzung nas/ slob ma'i spyi bor dkrol zhing ming sngar med pa la me tog la phog pa'i lha'i rigs nges par byas/ ming gdags te/ de yang rgyas par gur gyi le'u gsum pa nas 'byung ba bsdu na/ mi skyod pa'i rigs kyi skyes pa la kun gyi mthar rdo rje sbyar ba'i/ mi skyod/ zhe sdang dang*/ bzhad pa/ sgeg pa/ gnyis med/ mi phyed| rab dga'/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ dang po bud med la kun gyi mgor rdo rje sbyar nas/ bdag med ma/ mā ma kī lag ma/ rdo rje 'byung gnas ma'o/ rnam snang gi skyes pa la/ snang mdzad/ rtag pa/ oṃ mdzad/ sgyu ma/ gti mug shāka thub po/ bud med la spyan ma/ mkha' 'gro ma/ sgeg ma'o/ /rin 'byung gi skyes pa la/ rin chen/ nor bu/ nam mkha'/ ser sna/ gzi brjid/ bud med la rin chen sgrol ma/ do shal ma/ 'bar ma/ phreng ma'o/ /'od dpag med kyi skyes pa la/ snang mtha'/ spyan ras gzigs/ 'dod chags/ gsung gi chos kyi/ mtsho skyes so| |bud med la/ gos dkar mo/ dbyangs can ma/ blo gros ma/ glu ma'o// don grub kyi skyes pa la/ don yod/ rta mchog phra dog dam tshig las kyi'o// bud med la dam tshig sgrol ma/ sgyu 'phrul ma/ rgod ma/ gar ma'o/ /rigs drug pa'i skyes pa la/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa'o/ /bud med la/ rdo rje dbyings phyug ma dang*/ snyems ma sogs so/ /chu dbang man chad sngar bzhin las/ gti mug gzugs/ me long lta bu rnams sbyar ro/ /de ltar rig pa'i dbang lnga thob pas/ gur las/ dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med do/ sangs rgyas ye shes lta bar gyis/

/zhes dang bshad rgyud rdo rje'i phreng ba las/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni dag pa'i bdag /dbang lnga thob pa'i rgyu las ni/ /ma rig pa ni lnga spangs nas/ /ye shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don sbyong byed lnga po des/ sbyang bya phung po lnga dang*/ nyon mongs lnga sbyangs nas/ sbyangs 'bras rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga thob par byed cing bskur byed rig mas gtso bor bskur bas na rig dbang lnga zhes bya ba yin zhing*/ gtso bor bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud kyi ston pa por 'gyur pa yin pas/ snang ba thams cad rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du shes par gyis shig ces brda sprad do/ /brtul zhugs ni/ bdag nyid stong par gyur stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las| rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas rdo rje snyem ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ zhes pa nas ye shes pa dgug gzhug byas/ bla mas rdo rje hūṃ las byung pa'i rdo rjer byas nas gtad la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singngh-i badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ dha ra ya mi/ badzra sa twa hi hi hi hūm̐/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig ces brjod cing*/ slob mas kyang don dran bzhin pas de bzhin du bzung ngo*/ /'di rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi dam tshig gi khyad par can du 'dod pa dang*/ slob ma'i dbang gi nang dang bsdud pa gnyis 'gal te rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ma thob bar du rigs drug pa'i sa bon mi thebs par/

rnal 'byor rgyud dang dkyil chog mtha' dag las ma bshad pas so/ /de na dbang 'di yan chad thob pa'i dam tshig nyer gnyis bsrung dgos pa dang*/ bya spyod tsam sgrub par dbang ba gnyis kyang 'gal te nyer gnyis po rgyud sde gong ma gnyis kyi dam tshig yin pas so| |sngags sdom thob pa tsam gyis de bsrung dgos pa yin te/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i dang por 'byung ba'i yul la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yan chad thob par dgos pa rang lugs la 'dod pas so/ /des na brtul zhugs 'di la brtan byed kyi chu dbang dgos pa'i nges pa med do/ /gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la sbyor dngos mjug gsum mo/ /
