dang po ni de'i don du manṭal phul/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon pos bdag la bstsal nas kyang*/ /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*/ /slob dpon phrin las yongs su bzung*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang/ /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ dbang bskur gyi don du dbang stegs la dngos su bzhag bdag 'jug la mos nas bya ste de yang bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgyun zin bris la sa/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par mdzad pa ni 'phags pas longs sku'i rdo rje 'chang zhal gcig phyag gnyis par yod pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas mdzad pa dang sngags gzhan las kyang 'di zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsungs pa rnams dang mi mthun pas phyag gnyis par bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs rin po che'i khrir/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan dang*/ gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang / rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang 'phan dang rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang phyogs kun tu chu bzhi sngon du song ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis bskor ba/ steng gi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pas gang bar gyur pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid drug pa rdorje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje sogs nas/ chu dbang gi skabs kyi ye shes pa dgug gzhug bzhin byas la rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi rnam par zhes sbyar ro/ /rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjer 'gyur|

thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba cha| |kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag/ bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /oṃ mahā badzra hūṃ/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi rang bzhin/ thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa thams cad las grol ba yin la/ de rdo rje 'dis mtshon pa yin cing rang gi sems kyang de'i rang bzhin du shes pa'i rdo rje'i dam tshig dran par gyis la rdo rjai bzung shigadril bu stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i dril bur sbyangs/ 'di de rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad| khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed| sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi rang bzhin srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag pa ston par byed pa'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yin la de dril bu 'dis mtshon pa yin zhing*/ rang gi ngag kyang de'i rang bzhin du shes pa'i dril bu'i dam tshig dran par gyis la dril bu zung shig slob mas kyang rdo rje snying khar bzung*| dril bu 'khrol bzhin du don dran bzhin pas/ āḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe āḥzhes brjod/ bla mas/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung/ /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis bzung*/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas| |bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig zhes su bshad/ / yid kyi lus kyi bstan phyir ro/ /rang lus lha'i sku phyag rgya chen po ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyor ba de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i rang bzhin du shes pa'i sgo nas phyag rgya'i dam tshig dang mi 'bral bar gyis shigaganyis pa dngos gzhi ni/

mdor na rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dril bu gsung gi dam tshig lha'i sku phyag rgya chen po'i dam tshig ste/ dam tshig gsum dang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas rang rdo rje 'chang yab yum phan tshun 'khyud pa la dmigs pa ched du gtad pa las skyes pa'i bde ba chen po dang stong pa nyid zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par gyur/ de ni slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo yin te rtsa rgyud las shes rab bcu drug len pa la/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de brtan byed kyi chu dbang ni bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i ces pa nas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ ces pa'i bar sngar gyi chu dbang ji bzhin byas nas| oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ya swāhā/ zhes brjod la me tog dor zhing*/ sngar ltar mchod do/ /de ltar na rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /bzung shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs| |de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis| |dam tshig gsum gyi sgo nas rdo rje 'chang du byin gyis brlabs zin pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba thams cad khur du khyer bar bya'o/ /zhes brjod/ gsum pa mjug la bzhi las/ de nyid bstan pa la yang gsum las rten dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid ni dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad par/ /yid kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa yin/ / gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni/ /sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs 'phags| |de yi phyi rol gru bzhi ni/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /byams pa la sogs sems gang yin/ /thig skud bzhir ni yang dag bshad/ /thig gdab yang dag bshad pa ni/ /chos rjes dran pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /lta ba kun las rnam grol ba/ /ye shes thig tu bshad pa yin/ /rgyan rnams yang dag bshad pa ni| |tshul khrims la sogs sdoms pa mchog /dad dbang la sogs sems gang yin| |ra ba lngar ni yang dag 'byung*/ /rnam par thar pa bzhi po ni/ /sgo rnams su ni yang dag bshad/

/ka bar bcas pa'i rta babs bzhi/ /yang dag yong ba rnam pa bzhi/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi po ni/ kha khyer bzhir ni shes par bya/ /sgo khyud ces ni gang bshad pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam pa bzhi/ /byang chub yan lag rnam bdun ni/ /phreng ba me tog chun 'phyang ldan/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni/ /ka ba brgyad ces bya bar bshad/ /sgrib pa kun las rnam grol ba'i| |ting 'dzin ye shes kyis brtags pa/ /lam gyi ye shes khyad par 'phags| |rnga yab ces ni yang dag bshad/ /nyon mong thams cad 'joms pa'i phyir/ /do shal zhes ni yang dag bshad/ /nyon mongs phyed ni 'joms pa'i phyir| |do shal phyed pa zhes brjod do/ /nyon mongs 'phrog pas ra ba nyid/ / kun tu spyod pa'i khyad par gyis/ /tshogs gnyis kyis ni 'byor pa yis/ /'khor lo bskor ba bla na med*/ /rang gi lus kyi bu ga brgyad dang*/ snod kyi 'jig rten rnam par dag pas dur khrod dang bcud kyi sems can rnam par dag pas de na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong sogs so/ /brten pa lha'i rnam dag ni/ gtso bo yab yum ni rnam shes dag pa chos dbyings ye shes/ gau rī ni/ gzugs phung dag pa me long ye shes/ tsau rī ni/ tshor phung dag pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ baitā lī ni/ 'du shes dag pa sor rtog ye shes/ ghasma ri ni/ 'du byed dag pa bya grub ye shes| |pukka sī sogs bzhi ni sa dag pa byams pa/ chu dag pa snying rje/ me dag pa dga' ba/ rlung dag pa btang snyoms tshad med kyi rang bzhin yin no/ /slob dpon gyi de nyid ni/ de thams cad rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus la tshang ste/ rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /'di yi gzugs kyi phung po ni/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma ste/ / 'du shes padma gar dbang phyug /'du byed de bzhin rdo rje rgyal/ /rnam par shes pa mi skyod pa/ /kun gyi ngo bo he ru ka

/zhes sogs ltar ro/ / rjes gnang la/ mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don bsgrub pa dang/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi rjes gnang gi rdzas rnams tshogs par byas la/ slob ma sgeg sogs so so'i nga rgyal dang rjes zlos byed du gzhug cing*/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas pa rnam rol zhing*/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyis/ /āḥces pas sgeg mo dang*/ /sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang*| |sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur| |phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ ces pas phreng ba ma dang*/ /lus can kun gyi dam chos ni/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ /myur du bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /gī zhes pas ni glu ma dang*// de nyid thal mo gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /ho ces pas ni gar ma dang*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul shugs bzang pos legs bgos pa'i/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /hūṃ ces pas ni spos ma dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yis/ /bder gshegs sku ni thob par gyis/ /bhruṃ ces pas ni me tog ma dang*| |chos kyi me ni legs spar bas/ /rdo rje chos dag 'dra ba ru// sems can ma rig ldongs pa la/ /ye shes sgron mes gsal bar gyis/ /pra ces pas ni mar me dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*| |rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yis/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ gha| ces pas dri mchog ma rnams kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas rgyal ba mchod pa dang*/

de dag gis tshur mchod pa bdag gir byed pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang mi 'bral bar gyis shigaganyis pa ni/ mig thur dang*/ me long mda' gzhu rnams so/ /dang po ni/ bla mas slob ma la dngos su bya zhing*/ bdag 'jug gi tshe/ rang gi mig gnyis la ma rig pa'i ling thog gi rang bzhin yi ge praṃ nag po re re gnas pa bla mas gser gyi mig thur gyi rtse la gnas pa'i mig sman mtshan nyid dang ldan pas bsal bar gyur/ oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hri/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnam kyis bsal/ /ma rig pa'i ling thog dang bral nas ye shes kyi spyan dbye bar gyur/ des chos thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar lta dgos zhes bstan pa'i phyir du ā las skyes pa'i me long a chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /der ni gsal dag rnyog pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs| |rang bzhin med cing gnas med par/ /chos rnams de ltar shes gy-is la| |sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// spyir chos thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu dang khyad par rang gi snying la shar ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' me long gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar shes par gyis shig ces pa me long lan gnyis mi dgos so/ /ho las skyes pa'i mda' gzhu ho/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su mnyes par gyis shigaces pas gtad/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su mnyes par bgyi'o// zhes slob mas blangs la phyogs bzhi steng 'og dang drug tu chos dbyings kyi 'ben 'bigs pa'i ched du 'phen pa'i stangs bya'o/ /yang na rā ga ṇa chags pa la 'jug cing sems can gyi don la sbyar ba'i skabs yin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rjes su chags par gyis shig sogs sbyor ro/

/ gsum pa ni/ 'khor lo rkang 'og dang dung glegs dril bu rnams rim pa bzhin lag tu gtad la/ bhruṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ oṃ badzra he tu maṃ/ dbyangs tha ma aḥlas byung ba'i du/ oṃ badzra bha ṣa raṃ/ dbyangs dang po a las byung ba'i kyai'i rdo rje'i po ti a/ dbyangs tha ma aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe āḥ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yi/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyis the tshom dgos med cing*/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /skye bo yongs la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*/ khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces pa thun mong du dang*/ rigs so so'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i don du rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan so sor gtad cing*/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor| |de bzhin du chos kyi gnas su/ rdo rje/ rin po che/ padma/ las kyi zhes pa rnams gzhug go /'dir lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod gsum/ 'phags pas bdag 'jug tu mchog dbang gsum po'i mtha' brten so so la sbyar ba bzhin bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgyun du'ang 'byung mod/ spyir 'di gsum bum dbang dang 'brel pa'i phyir bum dbang tsam don du gnyer ba la yang 'di gsum sbyin dgos pa'i phy-ir dang*/ dkyil chog gi rgya gzhung khungs thub gang du'ang de ltar mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ khyad par lung bstan sprul skus byed par mdo sngags gang gi lugs la yang nges shing de'i tshe bla ma sprul sku'i cha byad can du bsgyur bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/

lung bstan gyi phyag rgya de bsgyur ba'i rgyun de nyid la dbugs dbyung byed par khungs thub kyi gzhung nas bshad pas de longs sku dang chos sku'i rnam pa can gyi bla mas byed pa mi bde ba'i phyir ro/ / des na rje btsun gong mas skabs 'dir mdzad pa ltar 'phags pa nyid kyis slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i cho gar bshad pa ltar bya'o/ / de nas lung bstan pa ni/ bla ma snam sbyar gyon pa'i phyag g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa glang po che'am seng ge'i rna ba ltar snying khar bzung*/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas pa bya/ bdag 'jug gi tshe bla ma rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i cha lugs can du bzhugs pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad dang mgrin gcig tu rang nyid lung bstan par mdzad pa ni/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan| |rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas ni/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye dpal chen po rdo rje zhes gsungs pa// de bzhin gshegs pa singnghi sa ma ya st+wāṃ bhur bhu wa swaḥ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /dbugs dbyung ni/ bla ma la slob mas brkyang phyag lan gsum byas te/ bla ma'i zhabs la btud nas lus phul/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'dud pa dang bcas pas 'dug la/ bla mas/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i// slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /zhes pas lha la phul/ de nas slob ma la/ da ni khyod ni slob dpon te/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par gsungs// sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin// rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/

/sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /zhes pas 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung dang*/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing*/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smad par mi bya zhing*/ /sems can rnams las gdug byams dang*/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /bdag gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ /skal med de nyid gtam mi bya/ /bdag gi lus la nges mi smad/ /chos la yid gnyis spang bya zhing*/ /gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya/ /chos nyid tshad ni bzung mi bya/ /skal ldan sems can spang mi bya/ /dam tshig rtag tu bskyang par bya| |bud med nyid la nges mi smad/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya/ /dam tshig rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu bzung bar bya/ /gtsug gtor rtag tu bcang bar bya/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ /rtag tu bde gsheg rab gnas bya/ /'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /rtag par rgyun du gsang sngags bzlas| |bsam gtan kyang ni rnam par spyad/ /rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing*// rtag pa ru ni bshad par bgyi/ /rtag tu sems can bskyang par bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya/ /dzambha lha la chu sbyin zhing*/ /las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad/ /bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang*/ /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya| |zhes brjod/ /phyag rgya bcings pa sogs rdzogs rim gyi dam tshig yin no| |gzengs bstod ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yi/ /de ring sdig las rnam grol 'gyur/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyis ni 'chi ba yod min pas// mi thub pa dang mi tshugs pas/ /cis kyang ma 'jigs dga' bar gyis/

/srid pa shin du dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las grol/ /zhes brjod do/ /de ltar bum dbang bcu gcig rdzogs nas/ dbang don la rtogs pa bskyed nas/ de ltar dkyil 'khor bzhi las rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi las bum pa'i dbang thob/ dri ma bzhi las lus kyi dri ma spyi dgos dgadam tshig bzhi las rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang*/ sbom po brgyad de nyer gnyis bsrung*/ lam bzhi las skyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu bzhi las mchog gi sprul sku'i rten 'brel khyad par can bskrun pa yin no/ /zhes brjod do/ /

gnyis pa gsang dbang la sbyor ba ni/ bla ma longs skur mos nas/ rta glang sogs kyi yon dang gser gyi maṇḍal rig mas brgyan pa dbul/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs nas/ /yid kyis dgyes kyi bar lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bla mas slob ma la mig dar bcing*/ 'bru gsum brjod pa'i bdud rtsis gtor/ dngos gzhi/ bla ma dgyes pa rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ rig ma stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje bdag med ma mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i yum gyi mkha' zhes sogs mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ ku ru ṣwa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba sgyu ma lta bu'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs spyi bo nas zhugs rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu zhu ba sku'i dbyibs brgyud dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor bstan par gnas pa yum gyi bha gar babs/ bla ma'i mtheb srin gyis phyung nas slob ma'i lce thog tu bzhag cing*/ ji ltara'adas pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bla mas brjod/ slob mas/ a ho ma hā su kha bla ma yab yum gyi gsang rdzas myangs pas bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyes shing byang sems des lus thams cad theg les gang bas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa thams cad 'gags/ gsung rnam par dag pa 'od dpag med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ mjug ni/ bla mas/ he badzra pā shya/ zhes brjod nas mig dar phye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi gtor/ de ltar dkyil 'khor bzhi las bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi las gsang ba'i dbang thob|

dri ma bzhi las ngag gi dri ma spyir dgos dag dam tshig bzhi las gsang rdzas bsten pa dang*/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ lam bzhi las gtum mo bdag byin rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu bzhi las longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rten 'brel thams cad mngon du byas so/ / gsum pa shes rab ye shes la sbyor ba ni/ bla ma chos kyi skur mos nas/ rig ma mtshan nyid tshang ba dang reg bya khyad par can yon du phul ba'i maṇḍal dang bcas te/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya bsgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*/ /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bla mas slob ma'i mig dar bcing sngar bzhin du bdud rtsi gtor ro/ / dngos gzhi ni/ slob ma rang nyid skad cig gis kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par gnas pa la bla mas rig ma lo bcu drug gi lang tsho dang ldan pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa zhig gi lag pa nas bzung ste/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo 'di/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis| |zhes gsung zhing gnang bar gyur/ lha mo des kyang 'di skad ces/ gshang lci dag ni za ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro ba'am| |bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i pad mo tsumbha ni/ khyod ni ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /zhes dris pa la slob mas de'i lan gsum gdab pa'i bsam pas/ gshang lci dag ni za ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par cis mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i padma tsumbha ni| |bdag ni ci dgar spro gyur to/ /zhes brjod pas lha mo de mnyes nas gcer bu gos dang bral bas bde ba chen po'i byung gnas chu skyes rgyas pa slob ma la ston cing*/

e ma bdag gi padma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ / cis te cho ga bzhin bsten nas/ /de yi 'dun na nga gnas so/ /sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba ji bzhin padmas byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni| |'di nyid du na rtag tu bzhugs/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /padma bhañtsa mo kṣa ho zhes gsungs nas slob ma'i pang du byon/ de nas slob ma skad cig gis kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i yum gyi mkha' sogs nas sngags gnyis brjod/ dbang bskur la mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgom du gzhug cing bdag 'jug la'ang spro na de ltar bsgom/ de nas skad cig dang po tsumbha dang 'khyud pa'i dus su dga' ba/ gnyis pa srub pa dang sbyor ba'i tshe mchog dga'| gsum pa phyi'i chags pa dang bral ba'i tshe dga' bral/ bzhi pa rtog pa thams cad las grol ba'i tshe lhan skyes kyi ye shes nyams su myong*/ yang de'i tshe byang sems spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pas mchog dga'/ snying kha nas lte bar sleb pas dga' bral/ lte ba nas gsang bar sleb pa lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsgom pa ni yas 'bab kyi dga' bzhi'o/ /de nas hūm̐/ yum gyi dwangs ma dang bcas pa'i byang sems btsan thabs kyis gyen du drangs pa lte bar byon pa na dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ spyi bor lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ lus thams cad thig les gang zhing bde bas khyab/ bde stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par gyur| mjug ni/ mig dar dbye ba sogs snga ma bzhin byas/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar| khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /phyag rgya bcing ba rnams spang zhing*/ /mchod rten las ni mi bya ste/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya/

/dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las/ /rmi lam du yang mi bya'o/ /slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya/ /bla ma'i rgan rabs phyag bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bzhi las zhes sogs sngar bzhin sbyar nas/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma spyi dgos dgadam tshig thig le mi nyams par bsrung*/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i rten 'brel thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mngon du byas so| | bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che la sbyor ba ni/ gser dang bai duryā la sogs pa'i yon dang maṇḍal phul/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bka' drin gyis ni skyab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ 'bru gsum brjod pa'i bdud rtsi gtor/ slob ma lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du byas la/ dngos gzhi ni/ bla mas/ ye shes 'di ni che phra zhing*/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ / rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ khyed rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don 'phags pa rin po ches/ de yang rang gi sems nyid yin/ /thog mtha' med cing skye 'gag med/ /rang gi ngo bo stong pa'o/ /dngos po kun gyi chos nyid mchog/ngo sprad tshig gi bzhi pa'o/ /de yi ye shes skye ba ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis| |don gyi ye shes phyag rgya dang*/ /bcas pa bsten te dus kun tu/ /goms byed lam gyi bzhi pa'o/ /'gros bzhi thim nas 'grub pa gang*/ /mngon byed don gyi bzhi pa yin/ /zhes dbang bzhi pa la gsum du mdzad pa yang bsdu na/ dbang gnyis pa'i bstan bya dang bsgrub bya'i gtso bo sku dang*/ gsum pa'i de gnyis kyi gtso bo thugs te/ de gnyis lam dus su ya ma bral ba bsgom pa dang*/ 'bras dus su rdzogs par zung du chug pa'i zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan nam/

dbang phyug brgyad ldan du gyur pa de nyid thob bya'i mthar thug tu tshig gi sgo nas brda sprad pa'i don go ba ni smin byed lam gyi dbang bzhi pa yin no/ /zhes sogs blo nus dang bstun nas brda sprad do/ /mjug ni/ de ltar dkyil 'khor bzhi las| don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ zhes sogs sbyar nas/ tshig dbang rin po che thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dgadam tshig khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya zhes sogs dgongs te gsungs pa rnams bsrung*/ lam rdo rje rba rlabs dang bsam mi khyab bsgom pa la dbang 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i rten 'brel thams cad rdzogs par mngon du byas so/ / zhes dbang don bshad do/ /de nas bla mas/ slob ma rnams dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la gces spras byed du gzhug pa'i don du dam tshig rnams mdor bsdus nas brjod par bya ste de yang bsrung bya'i dam tshig ni thun mong gi sdom bzung gi don rig pa'i dbang lnga dang/ thun mong ba spyir mi dge bcu spaung*/ khyad par so thar gyi rab dge slong pha ma 'bring dge tshul pha ma/ tha ma dge bsnyen pha ma'i bslab pa byang sems kyi rtsa ba dang*/ yan lag gi ltung pa rnams yin la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig rigs lnga'i sdom bzung gi don rtsa ltung bcu bzhi sbom po brgyad dang bcas pa gsang dbang gi gsang rdzas mi spong zhing*| gtum mo nyams pa bsrung pa gsum pa'i rig ma la ma gus pa dang*/ thig le nyams pa bsrung ba/ bzhi pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum ya bral du bsgom pa spong ba rnams dang*/ bza' bya'i dam tshig log 'tsho spong ba dang*/ khyad par sha lnga rtag tu bsten cing tshogs 'khor ci nus su bya ba dang*/ nang gi sbyin bsreg zas nam za ba'i dus su byed pa dang*/ dbang po'i yul thams cad bde stong gi zas su shes pa rnams dang*/ bsten bya'i dam tshig rdo rje dril bu dang*/

glegs bam bris sku sogs mtshan nyid tshang ba de kho na nyid dang mi 'bral bar bsten cing*| phyag chen dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya 'bral med dang*/ las kyi phyag rgya nus pa dang sbyar nas bsten nas/ dam tshig thams cad kyi rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon sgo thams cad nas dus thams cad bsten dgos tshul gyi gdam ngag tu skabs dang sbyar ba bshad la/ de nas slob mas kyang 'bad pa drag pos khas blangs pa'i bsam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi| |deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtang rag gi maṇḍal dang yon dbul lo/ / gsum pa mjug gi cho ga la/ mchod bstod gsol gdab bzod gsol bsngo/ bsdu dang rang nyid bsrung ba'o/ /zhes pa bdun las/ dang po mchod bstod ni gtang rag gi mchod pa ci 'byor bsham/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ dkyil 'khor pa dang gtor mgron ma gshegs pa rnams la mchod bstod/ gtor ma gang 'grub bya'o/ / gsol gdab ni bstan pa spyir dgos rgyas pa la sogs pa 'dod don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /bzod gsol ni rgyud mngon brjod bla ma las 'byung ba/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis na/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid rtsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces sogs kyis bzod gsol rgyas par bya/ yi ge brgya pa dang grub na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi kha bskang ngo*/ bsngo ba ni bla ma dang*/ yi dam dpa' bo dang mthun gyur du bzhugs par mos nas/ dgongs su gsol sngon du btang ste bzang po spyod pa sogs kyi bsngo ba spyi dang*/ khyad par rigs su skye dang zhes sogs rgyas par brjod do/ /gshegs gsol ni/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / ces sogs kyi mthar yi ge brgya pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥ
